name: Incyte Corporation
business: Biopharma: Jakafi (myelofibrosis/PV), Opzelura cream (vitiligo, eczema), plus an oncology/dermatology pipeline (povorcitinib).

news.title: Q2 revenue $1.674B (+38%); FY26 net sales guide $5.13–5.26B, Opzelura raised to $1.05–1.10B
Conference: Jakafi XR expected to retain ~$750M through the Jakafi patent transition

pros: Fortress balance sheet: {cash} cash, almost no debt
Growth +38% with operating margin {om}; povorcitinib US launch expected Q1 2027
cons: Jakafi patent cliff — the core franchise faces generics
Part of 2026 Opzelura sales from a one-off CMS settlement ($300–310M)
Binary pipeline readouts (HS / prurigo nodularis Phase 3 in Q4)
take: Cheap, cash-rich biotech growing fast now, but the stock is a bet that the pipeline outruns the Jakafi cliff.

metrics.summary: Incyte Corporation, a biopharmaceutical company, engages in the discovery, development, and commercialization of therapeutics in the United States, Europe, Canada, and Japan.
